results.raw_content: [Back to Search Programs](/search) # Master Informatique — Intelligent Systems and Applications [Université de Tours](/university/universite-de-tours) France2 yearsTaught in FrenchOpen to international students ## About Master Informatique — Intelligent Systems and Applications At Université de Tours, tuition costs 250 EUR per year. Computer science trains students to design, build, and analyze the software and systems that underlie modern computing, spanning algorithms, programming languages, databases, and system architecture. A track focused on intelligent systems narrows this foundation toward artificial intelligence and its applications, covering topics such as machine learning, knowledge representation, automated reasoning, and the design of software that can adapt to new data or situations. The Master Informatique — Intelligent Systems and Applications at Université de Tours, based in Tours, follows this orientation, preparing students to both understand the theoretical underpinnings of intelligent systems and apply them to concrete problems. Typical coursework includes machine learning algorithms, natural language processing, computer vision, and software engineering practices for building reliable systems, often reinforced through programming projects and applied case studies. Students also develop skills in evaluating models, managing data pipelines, and integrating intelligent components into larger software systems, which are increasingly central to industries ranging from finance to manufacturing to healthcare. Group projects and internships are common features of programs in this area, giving students exposure to how intelligent systems are built and deployed outside the classroom. Graduates typically pursue careers as software engineers, machine learning engineers, data scientists, or research and development specialists, and the degree also provides a strong basis for doctoral research in artificial intelligence or computer science more broadly. Given the pace of change in the field, programs of this kind emphasize both current techniques and the underlying principles that allow graduates to adapt as tools evolve. This is a two-year master's degree taught in French, starting in September, with yearly tuition of 250 EUR. Instruction, coursework, and evaluation take place in French throughout the program in Tours. Planning the visa?
